title: inari-platform values

gateway.description: parentRef to an ALREADY-EXISTING Gateway. The chart never creates a Gateway/GatewayClass; a Gateway controller and Gateway must be deployed beforehand. Required (gateway.name) when any *.route.enabled=true.

existingSecret.description: Name of a pre-provisioned secret (e.g. Vault/ESO) carrying inari-uri, openfga-uri, openfga-password, postgres-password, username, password (and keycloak-* keys only for the bundled Keycloak).

roleSecrets.description: Only with existingSecret: per-role kubernetes.io/basic-auth secrets (username+password) for CNPG managed.roles.

baseUrl.description: Override the in-cluster/admin backchannel base URL. Empty = derived.

route.description: HTTPRoute exposing Keycloak via the Gateway referenced in gateway:.

annotations.description: Extra annotations added to the HTTPRoute.

adminRole.description: Client role on the inari-server client authorizing platform-admin API endpoints.

realmSync.description: Idempotent realm sync via keycloak-config-cli on every ArgoCD sync — keeps the realm (clients, mappers, users) in line with the chart across syncs, unlike the one-shot KeycloakRealmImport.

dexClusters.description: Per-tenant-cluster confidential clients cluster-<id>-dex for the cluster-local Dex (OIDC pass-through + token exchange into extension audiences). Secrets are realm-creation placeholders; runtime provisioning/rotation is owned by inari-server (W2).

id.description: Tenant cluster id; client id becomes cluster-<id>-dex.

secret.description: Realm-creation placeholder secret; rotated by inari-server, synced from Vault/ESO in real installs.

audiences.description: Extension audiences attached as optional client scopes aud-<audience> (default: kubernetes, inari-extension-gateway). Must match a realm client scope aud-<audience> defined in files/realm-inari.json; inari-server is deliberately excluded (audience separation: hub API tokens are minted directly by Keycloak, never via a tenant-cluster Dex).

adminClient.description: Confidential client (service account) used by inari-server / inari-operator for Keycloak Admin REST calls via client_credentials.

argocd.description: Per-user SSO for ArgoCD via the cluster-local Dex — the baseline contract the inari-server clusterdex module renders per tenant cluster (operator sunset Phase 2): fail-closed RBAC, local admin as break-glass, ESO-referenced secrets only. Assumes a manifest-installed ArgoCD (scripts/install-argocd.sh).

adminEnabled.description: Keep the local admin account enabled as the break-glass path (ClusterDex parity).

issuerUrl.description: Issuer of this cluster's Dex (e.g. https://dex.cluster-<id>.example.org).

clientSecretRef.description: ESO/Vault-synced Secret in argocd.namespace holding the Dex static-client secret; referenced via $<secret>:<key> indirection, never inlined.

policyDefault.description: Fail closed (ClusterDex parity): empty means no implicit access beyond the local admin account and mapped groups.

adminGroups.description: Keycloak group paths (via the Dex groups claim) mapped to role:admin.

viewerGroups.description: Keycloak group paths mapped to role:readonly.

extraPolicyCsv.description: Extra policy.csv lines appended verbatim (e.g. organization-derived group mappings).

secrets.description: Optional ESO projection of the registration-provisioned Dex material: the ArgoCD static-client secret and the Dex config.yaml Secret. References only — values never inline.

secretStore.description: ESO SecretStore/ClusterSecretStore holding the platform Vault.

vaultPath.description: Vault KV path holding the cluster's OIDC material (inari/clusters/<id>/oidc-client-secret).

keepOnUninstall.description: Add argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options=Prune=false and helm.sh/resource-policy=keep to the CNPG Cluster so a prune/uninstall does not wipe the database.

agent.description: inari-agent compatibility declaration rendered into the inari-agent-compat ConfigMap.

supportedRange.description: Semver range of supported inari-agent versions.

recommended.description: Exact agent version recommended for install/upgrade.

description: Platform glue chart for the Inari GitOps stack (CNPG Cluster, db secrets, Keycloak realm glue). This chart NEVER installs operators: the CNPG operator and the Keycloak operator (incl. their CRDs) are separate ArgoCD Applications. keycloak.enabled=true deploys a dedicated Keycloak instance via the existing operator; false uses keycloak.external (an existing instance).
